enumDescriptions: gcc 2.7.2.3 (m68k-cbm-sysv4-gcc in amix.toolchainPath): kernel, drivers and userland
amix.toolchain.description: AMIX cross toolchain used for builds, Makefile commands, generated tasks and IntelliSense. Kernel/driver objects always use gcc 2.7.2.3.

amix.toolchainPath.description: gcc 2.7.2.3: directory containing m68k-cbm-sysv4-gcc, as, ld, nm, and related tools. Empty: /opt/amix-cross/bin (OpenIndiana package developer/amix/gcc-27) if installed, else ~/opt/amix-cross/bin.

amix.target.description: gcc 2.7.2.3: target triple, also the tool prefix (<target>-gcc, <target>-ld, ...).

amix.sysroot.description: gcc 2.7.2.3: AMIX sysroot. Empty: /opt/m68k-amix-sysroot (package developer/amix/sysroot) with the packaged gcc-27, else ~/opt/amix-cross/m68k-cbm-sysv4/sysroot.

amix.crtDir.description: gcc 2.7.2.3: directory containing crt1.o, crti.o, and crtn.o. Empty: <sysroot>/usr/ccs/lib.

amix.cpu.description: gcc 2.7.2.3: target m68k CPU option passed as -m68020, -m68030, or -m68040.

amix.extraCFlags.description: gcc 2.7.2.3: extra C compiler flags for userland AMIX objects.

amix.kernelDefines.description: Preprocessor defines used for AMIX kernel/driver objects (always gcc 2.7.2.3).

amix.gcc14.toolchainPath.description: gcc 14: directory containing m68k-elf-gcc and its binutils. Empty: /opt/m68k-amix/bin (package developer/amix/gcc-14) if installed, else ~/opt/m68k-amix/bin.

amix.gcc14.sysroot.description: gcc 14: AMIX sysroot with the shared X11R6.3, Motif and CDE libraries (usr/x11r6, usr/motif, usr/dt, usr/local). Empty: /opt/m68k-amix-sysroot with the packaged gcc-14, else ~/opt/m68k-amix-sysroot. Also used for Motif by the CDE sample with gcc 2.7.2.3.

amix.gcc14.cpu.description: gcc 14: target m68k CPU option (-m68060 for the Z3660).

amix.gcc14.extraCFlags.description: gcc 14: extra C compiler flags for userland AMIX objects.

amix.gcc14.fixNeeded.description: gcc 14: after linking an executable, run amix-fix-needed so that AMIX ld.so.1 finds the NEEDED names at the start of .dynstr.

amix.makeCommand.description: Make command used for AMIX project builds. Empty: gmake on illumos/Solaris (where make is Sun make), make elsewhere. The AMIX Makefiles need GNU make.

amix.makeArgs.description: Additional arguments passed to make for AMIX project builds.

amix.agent.port.description: Port the listener for vscode-agent uses. The agent on AMIX dials this port (connect lines in /etc/vscode-agent.conf).

amix.agent.listenAddress.description: Address the agent listener binds to. 0.0.0.0: every interface, so a real Amiga on the network and FS-UAE (via its NAT) both reach it.

amix.agent.autoStart.description: Start the agent listener when the extension starts, if an agent key exists.

amix.run.program.description: Program Run on Target sends and runs, relative to the Makefile's folder. Empty: the AMIX executable there (asked when there are several).

amix.run.display.description: DISPLAY for the program: :0 is the Amiga's own screen (X and CDE programs open there while the agent's user is logged in). Empty: no DISPLAY.

amix.run.env.description: More environment variables for the program.

amix.run.files.description: More files to send with the program (data, resource files), relative to the Makefile's folder.

amix.run.buildFirst.description: Run make before sending the program; a failed build sends nothing.

amix.run.fetchCore.description: When the program dumps core, fetch the core file into the project as core.<program>.

program.description: The program to send and run, relative to cwd. Empty: the AMIX executable there (asked when there are several).

cwd.description: The folder with the Makefile and the program. Empty: the active file's Makefile folder.

display.description: DISPLAY on AMIX; :0 is the Amiga's own screen. Empty: none.

files.description: More files to send with it (data, resources), relative to cwd.

buildFirst.description: Run make first; a failed build sends nothing.

fetchCore.description: Bring a core file back as core.<program>.
